<b>Steelspine Kais</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are plump floaters able to extend sharp spikes from within their bodies, long lost to time and living on only in memory. 

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Floats around back and forth slowly.<br>
Suddenly extends spines all over its body, as well as moving towards Hornet slightly if she gets too close.<br>
Deals {{Damage|1}} of contact damage for all attacks.

== [[Needolin]] Dialogue ==
{{SS Needolin|columns=2|
* The crust covers...
* The crust conceals...
* Our shells made strong...
* Our nest made secret...
}}

== Location ==
Steelspine Kais can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
